steps.text: Combine sweetened condensed milk and chocolate chips in a saucepan over medium heat. Cook, stirring constantly, until the chips are melted and the mixture is smooth. Do not allow it to bubble.
Remove from heat and stir in vanilla. Cool slightly before drizzling over cake.

raw_recipe.headline: Easy Chocolate Bundt Cake Glaze
raw_recipe.description: This chocolate glaze for Bundt cake is simple to make and uses only three ingredients. Great over ice cream or on your favorite dessert as well.
raw_recipe.name: Easy Chocolate Bundt Cake Glaze

review.reviewBody: I unexpectedly decided to glaze a cake I had made to dress it up. I really wanted a chocolate ganache, but found I had no heavy cream--and then I remembered this recipe. In just a few minutes I had the most luxurious, fudgey icing, almost like a hot fudge sauce. This recipe saved my cake!

This turned out perfectly glossy and fudgy! I used some good quality dark chocolate and chopped it up finely, then mixed together with the sweetened condensed milk in a double broiler. I also added a splash of brandy which really took this glaze to the next level!

This was so easy and so delicious! I made it in the microwave. I mixed mini chips and the sweetened condensed milk in a small bowl and microwaved on high for 30 seconds. Stirred well and put in for another 10 seconds. I have an 800 watt microwave. It does make enough for at least two cakes, depending on how much you like on your cake, of course.

THIS IS TRULY THE BEST CHOCOLATE FROSTING I'VE EVER TASTED!!! I'm glad the calorie count didn't show up cause I was eating the leftover with a spoon! I used it on a bundt cake - had way too much - but continued to slowly pour it on thick cause I knew the girls at work would LOVE! Also because I couldn't stop eating it and couldn't bare throwing it away!! Thanks so much for such a simple yet delicious recipe. Using white chocolate chips sounds interesting - will have to give it a try!
Update: I've been using this wonderful recipe every chance I get - Now I use it to make the Best Fudge Ever. The only thing different is to use 3 cups Chips + 1/4 cup Butter...and maybe a pinch of Salt. Add nuts if desired. It fits nicely into a 8X8" pan :)

Simple and delicious. Used Ghirardelli dark chocolate pieces and whipping cream. Heated the cream in the microwave and poured over the choc pieces. Used the ganache for a topping for a choc bundt cake. Delicious!!

great chocolate glaze, very easy to make. I used the microwave to melt the ingredients, only took 2 min. stir to combine, microwave for 1 min, stir again microwave another min, stir add vanilla and done! this recipe does make a lot and I am not aware of how well or how long this keeps, but it sure is good and can be used in lots of ways you can think of. jwildman

I just made this for a Christmas party at work. I didn't have time to bake anything so I bought a freshly baked chocolate bundt cake, drizzled it with this glaze and topped it with crushed candy canes. Seven minutes total from start to finish and it looks festive and like I worked all night! Since other reviewers mentioned that it makes so much glaze, I literally halved the recipe (1/2 can sweetened condensed milk and 1/2 cup semi-sweet chocolate chips with a dash of vanilla). Made the perfect amount of glaze and now I have condensed milk to make more glaze for another cake next week! Great recipe!

Outstanding and super easy. I cooked it in the microwave 30 seconds at a time ( 2 minutes total) and stirred at each 30 sec interval. It makes enough for two cakes probably. But it is so good I was eating it with a spoon. I used it for the AR Too Much Chocolate Cake. Will definitely use it again.

This was great! Took the advice of another reviewer and used olive oil instead of shortening. I also used 1/3 cup olive oil and 1/3 cup apple sauce, substituted one of the cups of sugar with Truvia (Stevia), and added 1/2 tsp of ground cinnamon. So moist and satisfying!

Made this to top a boxed swiss chocolate cake made with hot coffee instead of water. It was the best boxed chocolate cake combination! Glaze set nicely and cake was good warmed up with chocolate ice cream on the side.
Taste was great. Was pretty runny (which is great for drizzling) but I placed my sheet cake in the freezer so icing would cool quickly. Worked just fine.
I used half the amount to glaze the incredible Chocolate pound cake III

This recipe was very easy to make. I spooned this glaze over my cooled cake a couple of hours before serving so that it had a chance to semi set up. This glaze is very rich and raises the level of deliciousness of my triple chocolate cake recipe. If you have extra, it refrigerates well. A great addition to not only your cake, but maybe even a great ice cream topper....YUM!
so easy to make, tastes delicious, and a beautiful sheen on the bundt cake
I make this yearly for my girls birthday's. They love this on the to much chocolate bundt cake!
It was delicious and so easy to make!

I can make a boxed cake mix, but homemade frosting is always a challenge. Too many ingredients, lots of confectioners sugar & beating it all together. But this recipe is a breeze! I had all ingredients in my pantry & the taste is amazing! Poured it over the chocolate Bundt cake I made. Delicious!
